name: Yokujou Kyoushi
source:
At Shinyuu Academy, the protagonist, Inui Ken, is an average student who doesn’t stand out much. But he’s been thoroughly enjoying his school life—thanks to the three beautiful teachers: Yuuho Akiyama (Japanese literature), Harumura Kaoru (mathematics), and Natsuki Kanako (physical education).
Every day, Ken takes advantage of the little glimpses he catches during class—the outline of their underwear, the curves of their bodies—letting his dirty imagination run wild. But one day, after school, one of the teachers corners him.

Will Ken’s fantasies become reality, or will things take an unexpected turn…?

translation:
在新友学园，主人公乾健是一名毫不起眼的普通学生。但多亏三名美丽的教师——教授日文的秋山游穗、教授数学的春村薰，以及体育教师夏木可奈子——他十分享受校园生活。

每天，健都会利用上课时偶然瞥见的内衣轮廓与身体曲线，任由下流的想象驰骋。然而某天放学后，其中一名教师将他逼入角落。

健的幻想会成真，还是事情将朝意料之外的方向发展……？
